rainium.add.empty_hint: Drop .obj, .gltf or .glb models (and .png textures) into the rainium folder.
rainium.edit.empty_hint: Use + Add layer to start from a preset or your own model.
rainium.import.no_faces: This file has no faces to show.
rainium.import.warn.extra_textures: The model uses %s more texture(s); only the first one is kept.
rainium.import.warn.no_faces: No faces in this file (only f lines can be rendered).
rainium.import.warn.no_uvs: No UVs: textures will show as one colour.
rainium.import.warn.texture_not_png: The model's texture isn't a PNG, so it wasn't kept. Save it as a PNG next to the model to use it.
rainium.import.warn.too_big: %s blocks across: try centimetres or Fit.
rainium.import.warn.too_small: Only %s blocks across: scale it up.
rainium.label.one_layer_per_part_in_a_fo: One layer per part, in a folder
rainium.layers.empty_hint: Add one from the presets or your own models.
rainium.name: Rainium
rainium.preset.halo.description: A floating gold ornament behind the head (example model)
rainium.preset.wings.description: Feathered wings with eyes, glow and an optional aura
rainium.preview.no_world: Join a world to see the preview
rainium.tip.armor_stands: Default for layers that don't choose their own: also show them on armor stands with the name below (give one a name tag). Only you see them.
rainium.tip.attach_to: What the layer follows. Body follows crouching and leaning, Head turns with your head, Body (no lean) stays upright, and arms and legs swing as you walk. Left and right are your own.
rainium.tip.automatic_updates: Once per launch, checks Rainium's GitHub releases for a newer version made for this Minecraft version, downloads it and installs it when you close the game. GitHub can see your IP address when it checks.
rainium.tip.axes: How the model was oriented when exported. Blender's default OBJ export is Y up, facing +Z.
rainium.tip.back: Moves it backwards, in blocks (negative goes forwards). Click the value to type.
rainium.tip.bob_speed: How fast the idle bob repeats.
rainium.tip.capture_fps: Frames per second for recordings. Set the same rate when importing the frames into a video editor.
rainium.tip.capture_size: Resolution of pictures and recordings, compared with the preview on your screen. Bigger takes more disk space and can drop frames while recording.
rainium.tip.capture_spin: Turns the preview while recording: slow is one turn every 12 seconds, fast every 6.
rainium.tip.copy_error: Copies the error text, to paste into a bug report or message.
rainium.tip.copy_style: Remembers this layer's look and placement, to paste onto another layer.
rainium.tip.custom_name: The name shown in folder paths. Click to type, Enter to save.
rainium.tip.damping: How quickly the bounce settles. Lower is wobblier.
rainium.tip.dev_updates: Also installs dev builds: early versions between main releases (like 0.3.1) that may have new features or bugs. Off by default.
rainium.tip.down: Moves it down, in blocks (negative goes up). Click the value to type.
rainium.tip.duplicate: Adds a copy of this layer right below it.
rainium.tip.export_zip: Makes a zip in the exports folder with these parts and their model and texture files. Others can add it from Add > Shared sets.
rainium.tip.fine_tune_motion: Shows every motion setting, for exact control.
rainium.tip.fit_to: Resizes the model so its largest side is this many blocks.
rainium.tip.folder: Which folder this layer belongs to.
rainium.tip.hide_while_gliding: Hides this layer while flying with an elytra.
rainium.tip.hue: Shifts every colour of the texture around the colour wheel. 0° keeps the original colours; ±180° is the opposite colour. Click the strip, scroll, or click the value to type.
rainium.tip.idle_bob: Gentle up-and-down motion while standing still.
rainium.tip.idle_sway: Gentle side-to-side motion while standing still.
rainium.tip.ignore_world_light: Draws at full brightness, even in the dark.
rainium.tip.left: Moves it sideways, in blocks (negative goes right). Click the value to type.
rainium.tip.max_trail: The furthest layers can trail behind, in blocks.
rainium.tip.max_turn: The most layers can lag when turning, in degrees.
rainium.tip.me_uuids: Player UUIDs that count as you, so they get your "Just me" layers. Use it for yourself in a Flashback replay, where you watch through a camera. Pick players from the list below, or type UUIDs separated by commas.
rainium.tip.mirrored_copy: Also draws a left/right mirrored copy, e.g. model one wing, show two. On an arm or leg, the copy goes on the other arm or leg.
rainium.tip.model: The mesh file this layer uses, from the rainium folder.
rainium.tip.model_axes: Pick Blender (Y up) if a model exported from Blender shows up upside-down or backwards.
rainium.tip.motion: How strongly this folder's parts sway with movement. 0% keeps them still, 100% is normal.
rainium.tip.motion_feel: How much your cosmetics move: from completely still to very bouncy. Applies to every layer with "Sway with movement" on.
rainium.tip.name_in_paths: What replaces your computer's account name wherever a folder path is shown, here and in messages: your in-game name, a name you choose, or nothing (~).
rainium.tip.normals: Lighting direction per vertex. From file is usually right; Flat gives a faceted look.
rainium.tip.on_players: Which players this shows on. Default follows the folder, then Settings > Visibility.
rainium.tip.on_stands: Whether this shows on armor stands, and on which names. Default follows the folder, then Settings > Visibility.
rainium.tip.opacity: How see-through the layer is. Affects the See-through and Glow styles. Click the value to type.
rainium.tip.origin_at: Feet if the model was made around a full-size character; Neck if made around a Minecraft player's neck.
rainium.tip.p_angle: Upright: every particle starts the right way up (Spin still turns them). Random: each starts at a random angle.
rainium.tip.p_area: Radius of the ball or ring, or half the width of the box, in blocks.
rainium.tip.p_end_size: How big particles are at the end of their life. 0 shrinks them away.
rainium.tip.p_fade: Particles become see-through as they age.
rainium.tip.p_follow: On: particles move along with you. Off: they stay where they appeared, leaving a trail.
rainium.tip.p_gravity: Pulls particles down as they move. Negative values make them rise.
rainium.tip.p_life: How long each particle lasts, in seconds (each one varies a little).
rainium.tip.p_rate: How many particles appear per second.
rainium.tip.p_shape: Where around the attachment point particles appear: one point, inside a ball, inside a box, or around a flat ring.
rainium.tip.p_size: How big particles are when they appear, in blocks.
rainium.tip.p_speed: How fast particles start moving, in blocks per second.
rainium.tip.p_spin: How fast each particle turns, in degrees per second.
rainium.tip.p_spread: How far each particle may stray from the direction, in degrees. 180 is any direction.
rainium.tip.p_when: When particles appear: all the time, only while moving, only while standing still, or more the faster you move.
rainium.tip.part: Which part of the model this layer draws. Whole model draws every part.
rainium.tip.particle_texture: The picture each particle shows: one of Minecraft's particles, or a PNG you put in the rainium folder.
rainium.tip.paste_style: Applies the copied look and placement to this layer (keeps its model and texture).
rainium.tip.picture: Saves a PNG of the preview with a transparent background, in the captures folder.
rainium.tip.players: Player names, separated by commas. Add your own name to include yourself.
rainium.tip.players_here: Players loaded around you. In a replay these are the recorded players: click Me next to yourself.
rainium.tip.record: Records the preview as numbered PNG frames with a transparent background. Video editors import the folder as one clip.
rainium.tip.remove_folder: Deletes these parts from your setup. Their files stay in the rainium folder.
rainium.tip.reset_preset: Puts this layer back the way the preset made it.
rainium.tip.roll: Rotation around the front-to-back axis, in degrees.
rainium.tip.scale: Extra scaling on top of the units. Click the value to type.
rainium.tip.show_on: Default for layers that don't choose their own: whose player shows them (only you, everyone, other players, players you list, or nobody). Only you see the result.
rainium.tip.size: Scale of the model in %. Click the value to type an exact number.
rainium.tip.split_by: How the model's pieces become parts you can style separately.
rainium.tip.springiness: How quickly layers spring back into place. Higher is snappier.
rainium.tip.stand_name: Armor stands with exactly this name tag (not case-sensitive) show your layers.
rainium.tip.stand_names: Name tags of the armor stands this shows on, separated by commas (not case-sensitive).
rainium.tip.starter_aura: A soft glow swirling around you.
rainium.tip.starter_blank: A plain emitter to set up yourself.
rainium.tip.starter_hearts: Hearts floating up while you stand still.
rainium.tip.starter_sparkles: Glitter drifting up around your back.
rainium.tip.starter_trail: Sparks left behind you as you move.
rainium.tip.step_size: How much each − / + click or scroll changes a value.
rainium.tip.style: Solid is opaque. See-through uses the texture's transparency. Glow adds light (black stays invisible); Soft glow is gentler. One-sided hides back faces.
rainium.tip.sway_speed: How fast the idle sway repeats.
rainium.tip.sway_with_movement: Lets the layer trail behind and sway as you move and turn.
rainium.tip.texture: The PNG painted onto the model. None draws it plain white.
rainium.tip.tilt: Rotation around the side-to-side axis, in degrees.
rainium.tip.tint: Colours the whole layer towards a colour: click the strip to pick it, and set how strong. Off keeps the original colours. Hue shifts the texture first, then Tint colours the result.
rainium.tip.trail: How far layers trail behind when you move.
rainium.tip.turn: Rotation around the vertical axis, in degrees.
rainium.tip.turn_lag: How much layers lag behind when you turn.
rainium.tip.ungroup: Keeps the parts as separate layers and removes the folder.
rainium.tip.units: The units the model was made in. Minecraft blocks are 1 metre.
rainium.update.ready: Rainium %s is downloaded and will be installed when you close the game.
rainium.value.anchor.head: Head
